name: Any host
note: Run the weights wherever you like
summary: The stack doesn't care where the model runs: a lab's own API, a hosted inference provider for open-weight models, a hyperscaler, or a local runtime on your own hardware. You point it at an endpoint.
how: Choose a host: a lab API, an open-model provider, a cloud platform or a local server
Point the agent at its OpenAI-compatible endpoint or a built-in provider
Swap hosts for price, speed or privacy without changing the agent
facts: Stacks whose docs support many hosts or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Speed, price and quantization differ between hosts serving the same model
goodFor: Moving to cheaper or faster hosts as they appear
Keeping data on your own hardware
watchOut: The same open model can behave differently across hosts (quantization, context limits)
